facts: The marker is a 24-byte AndroidX ProfileInstaller record; bytes 8-16 hold a millisecond timestamp. The baseline value predates this slice. The first v5 cohort snapshot already holds the later value, which falls 3 s before the last round-1 modern cohort finished its restoration (which reinstalls the original APK). Every v5/v6 cohort restored to that later value.
inference: The original app process started between the round-1 preservation pass and the first v5 cohort (not observed), and ProfileInstaller rewrote the marker to match the reinstall time. An install timestamp cannot be restored.
